comment: Written from src/NoteClassifier.cpp at commit b90cd69. The outputs are declared from B down to C but the lookup table note_outputs at line 105 maps note 0 to the C jack and note 11 to the B jack, so the tags follow that table rather than the enum order; the panel draws them as a piano keyboard running from C at the bottom to B at the top. A fault worth knowing: when the enable jack carries exactly one channel reading below 1V, the code skips readVoltages for that port (line 77) but still tests gate[i] for every channel of the pitch input, so channels past the first are compared against uninitialised stack memory. A monophonic gate is therefore only dependable with a monophonic pitch input; give the gate as many channels as the pitch.
